list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden), frozen 2026-11-18 from the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles, the two agreeing on every name, description and grade.
sources: Official list: Exophase, 'Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)' — every name, description and grade
PSNProfiles, 'Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies' — the progress count PlayStation tracks, where a trophy has one
Guide text: the author's own words, reasoned from the official descriptions; the game released 2026-11-19 and no walkthrough claim here is presented as verified in play

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, and the point of this whole guide: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap in this app — campaign first, stranger strands second, then collectibles, activities and the money totals — and let the tracker tick each one off as it lands.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the job the official description names as the game's first. It is on the critical path and cannot be missed: play the prologue through and the trophy lands as the mission wraps up.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Pure story progression: follow the mission markers while Lucia and Jason's opening arc plays out. No choices, collectibles or side content gate it, and it cannot be missed on any playthrough that finishes the chapter.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story progression again — the chapter works through the early money trouble the trophy's name (censored exactly as PlayStation prints it) jokes about. Nothing optional is required; finish the chapter's missions and it pops at the end.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep following the main mission strand; the trophy pops at the chapter's end card. If you are also chasing the one-time story beats flagged on the missables page, this chapter's missions are where several of them live.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Story progression only. Before pushing into the finale from here, close out any stranger strands you care about — the strand finals on the missables page carry a 'watch' flag for exactly this reason.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the campaign's gold. Before you start it, make a separate manual save and finish any open stranger strands: finales in this series can close threads, and the official list offers no second-chance trophy. The gold lands as the mission (and the story) ends; everything after is the road to 100%.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run, an early story job named in the official description. It sits on the critical path, so it cannot be skipped or failed permanently — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the campaign's big score against the cartel. A critical-path mission: the trophy pops on completion however the heist itself plays out, so take whatever approach the mission offers and see it through.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A main-story mission on the critical path; unmissable while you are following the campaign.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Main-story progression; the trophy lands when the mission closes, with nothing optional attached to it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the campaign's job at Vice City International Airport. While this arc is open, also grab Catch Me If You Can — an unscheduled departure at VCIA — because that one hangs off this part of the story and is flagged missable on this guide's missables page.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A main-story mission on the critical path; finish it and the trophy pops, nothing else required.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the long tail of the platinum, and the second gold. Story, strands, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the in-game completion counter, so most trophies in this list are waypoints toward it. When the percentage stalls, read the game's own completion screen for the category that is short instead of guessing: the counter is the game's, and the official description sets its target at the full 100%.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and set pieces scattered across Leonida, with PlayStation tracking the full 250. They are repeatable world content, so this silver is a grind, not a risk: sweep them region by region while you explore for The Goodtime State, and keep the counter here matched to the one PlayStation shows.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PlayStation counts 9 activity types. Sample one of everything the map offers (races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest) early in your run: it is the cheapest trophy on the list, and it teaches you where everything lives before the grind trophies send you back.
sources: PSNProfiles (the count PlayStation tracks: 9 activity types)
Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them, the count PlayStation tracks. Learn each range's target pattern at a bronze pace first, then chase gold once your weapon handling is upgraded: golds are accuracy under the clock, not firepower. The ranges stay open all game and every challenge can be retried, so nothing here is missable — it is the list's purest skill silver.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Drone races are handling tests: fly each course once to learn its gates, then push for the win. The trophy needs a win at every location, not gold times, so a scrappy first place counts exactly as much as a perfect run.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 'Different' is the operative word in the official description: repeating one easy race twenty times does not finish it. Work across the race series spread over the map, and tick each new win off here so you never re-run a race you have already banked.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Hangs off Cal's character strand; take the challenge when the strand offers it, and close character strands out before the final mission.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of Leonida's fishing contacts, and his challenge comes through his strand rather than the open map: take it when it is offered and land the better catch. It carries a 'watch' flag only because it hangs off a character — finish character strands before the finale and it cannot be lost.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one, not just start it. Cabinets sit in Leonida's bars and arcades; the shortest games are the cheapest way in. Master of None's activity sampling will walk you past a cabinet early, so pair the two.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger-strand final: the strand must be played through its earlier missions first, and strands are safest finished before the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the end of his whole stranger strand, not just his first job. Strand finals only appear after the strand's earlier missions, so work his marker whenever you pass it. It carries a 'watch' flag because strands are safest closed out before the final mission; it also counts toward Strangers & Freaks' 8 strands.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger-strand final: play Kenton's strand through to its last mission, ideally before the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the end of his stranger strand. As with every strand final, the last mission only unlocks once the earlier ones are done, so keep his strand moving when you are in his part of Leonida. 'Watch' flag: finish strands before the finale, and this also feeds Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger-strand final: play Billy's strand through to its last mission, ideally before the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the end of his stranger strand. Play the strand through in order; the final only appears after the earlier jobs are done. 'Watch' flag: close strands out before the final story mission, and this also feeds Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the silver umbrella over the strand finals. Five of the eight are named in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone); the rest are other strangers whose markers appear as you travel. Do strands as they appear rather than saving them all for the end, and this fills itself in on the way.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger-strand final: play Randy's strand through to its last mission, ideally before the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the end of his stranger strand. Work the strand in order; the final mission unlocks only after the earlier ones. 'Watch' flag: finish strands before the finale, and this also feeds Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: A stranger-strand final: play Tyrone's strand through to its last mission, ideally before the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the end of his stranger strand. Play the strand through in order and the final appears. 'Watch' flag: close strands out before the final story mission, and this also feeds Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, the count PlayStation tracks. The spots sit at scenic overlooks and quiet corners, so this is pure exploration: pair the hunt with The Goodtime State's map-clearing and tick each spot off here as the counter climbs.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Bret's strand sends you after one specific animal; follow the strand to its hunt rather than hunting wildlife at random.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand sends you after one specific animal, not the general wildlife: follow his strand to its hunt and make the kill when the animal shows. 'Watch' flag because it belongs to a character strand — play it when the strand offers it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found one by one across Leonida and gather into themed sets; the trophy counts completed sets, not single cards, so hunt set by set — a nearly-full set is worth a detour, while the first card of a fresh set can wait for the endgame sweep. This silver is about finishing, not just finding.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK service at 100 of its spots around the state, the count PlayStation tracks. The locations are fixed world points, so this silver is a map-clearing exercise: work district by district alongside The Goodtime State and let the counter here hold your running total.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's world challenges. They accumulate naturally while you do everything else on this list; if you finish the story short of 50, challenges keep appearing in free roam, so this is a patience trophy, not a missable one. Take them as they surface instead of farming them in one sitting.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner beside you while the wanted level drains; easiest during the story, while Lucia and Jason are together by default.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars while Lucia and Jason are together — crimes committed as the pair — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain completely. 'Watch' flag: it needs your partner with you, so do it during the story while the pair travel together rather than gambling on post-story availability.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner and one continuous wanted session; easiest during the story, and the chain resets if the wanted level fully drains between shops.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three store robberies inside one continuous wanted session: pick three shops in one neighbourhood, move fast between them, and never let the stars fully drain between robberies or the chain resets. 'Watch' flag because it needs your partner beside you — do it while the pair are together in the story.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get behind the wheel of 100 different vehicles so the game registers them. Traffic variety rises in richer districts and around the airport and docks; a deliberate hour of car-hopping across Vice City finishes most of the count, and it pairs naturally with On the Spot's registrations.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. You need one activation with five targets in reach: let a group close in — a gang operation or a busy mission firefight — trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Failing costs nothing; the next crowd is another attempt.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to VCIA, the airport of the VCIA Takedown story arc: the natural window is while that arc is open. Flagged from the official description, which ties the act to the airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport by an unplanned route: a stolen plane, a ramp out, anything the airport did not intend. Flagged missable because the natural window is the VCIA Takedown story arc, while you have a reason to be on the airfield; do it then rather than hoping the airport stays just as open afterwards.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: The description points at a Rhino (tank) encounter, and set-piece vehicles belong to their missions: when a Rhino appears in the campaign, that is the moment.
trophies.guide: The official description says only 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and a Rhino is this series' tank. The honest reading is a set-piece encounter with Rhinos during the campaign: when the story puts you in or against one, stay in the fight and finish the encounter rather than fleeing it. Flagged missable because set-piece vehicles belong to their missions; this guide flags the moment instead of inventing a location for it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: case the store first, take the goods and be gone before anyone raises the alarm — detection, not the robbery, is what fails it. Jewelry stores stay rob-able in free roam, so a blown attempt costs nothing but the retry.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, and each one only counts when it ends in a successful escape, which means losing the wanted level afterwards. Vaults are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: bring your partner, a fast car and a planned route out (water and rail lines break line of sight best). Repeatable in free roam, so this silver is planning, not luck.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The trucks run money routes in free roam: crack the rear doors (a heavy vehicle or explosives opens them), take the cash and lose the heat. As the name jokes, it is the series' oldest trick — and per the official description it still works.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — PlayStation counts 52 areas. The map fog lifts as you travel, and the last few percent are always outlying islands, keys and back roads: finish this with a deliberate boat or air circuit once the story is done, and sweep the collectible hunts (meditation spots, WAiNK locations) on the same passes.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, one operation apiece. Hitting every gang once matters and hitting one gang nine times does not, so spread your robberies across the territories and tick the gangs off here as each one falls.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: The name (with its ellipsis, as PlayStation prints it) and its place at the story's start suggest an early-game moment; do it on an early Ocean Beach visit.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet one: order the drink at an Ocean Beach spot and take in the view. The ellipsis in the official name and its place at the story's beginning earn it a 'watch' flag — do it on an early visit to Ocean Beach rather than leaving it to the endgame.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — get into a car on the showroom floor and drive it out through the glass. Showrooms are open-world locations, so this is repeatable at leisure: pick something fast on the floor and make the exit dramatic.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a game of bowling there, the series' oldest pastime in a new suit of clothes. The alley is a fixed world location, open whenever you are; combine the visit with Master of None's activity sampling.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description reads as a set story moment for the pair, not a repeatable activity. Flagged from the description; if a campaign beat puts Lucia and Jason before a crowd or a camera, play it out.
trophies.guide: The official description says only 'A partnership with mass appeal' — which reads as a set story moment for Lucia and Jason rather than a repeatable activity. Flagged missable on that reading: if a mission puts the pair in front of a crowd or a camera, play the beat out instead of rushing past it. This guide flags it honestly rather than inventing a location the description does not give.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: PlayStation tracks a count to 500, but each individual choice is one-time: a playthrough that always answers the same way may starve one branch of the counter.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — PlayStation tracks a count to 500, so this is the game's long choice counter rather than a single decision. It is flagged missable in a narrower sense: individual choices are one-time, so vary your calls when a choice is offered instead of always picking the same way, and let both characters' storylines run their course.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: The description describes succeeding on a second attempt — a flawless playthrough offers nothing to retry, so do not reload after a failure.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: the official description describes succeeding after a first failure. Flagged missable because a flawless, reload-happy playthrough offers nothing to retry — when a challenge, race or job goes wrong, do not reload the save; take the second attempt the game offers and this should land.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A placed, scripted strange event rather than a random spawn: when something odd starts, stop and watch it play out instead of driving on.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness one of Leonida's strange events. Flagged missable because scripted oddities are placed, not spawned: when something weird starts — lights, strangers, an animal that should not be there — stop and watch it play out instead of driving on, and the trophy should witness it with you.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a crowded pavement and swing as you pass: speed kills the melee window, so a crawl and a weapon's reach is the whole technique. Repeatable anywhere there are pedestrians.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from scores; run them through your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw, and the laundered total climbs toward the quarter million PlayStation tracks. This is an endgame money total — the late story's heists are what feed it.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all count, as long as it is shop spending. You will pass most of it naturally outfitting two protagonists; if you are short at the end, vehicle customisation burns money faster than anything else in the game.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages across Leonida, the count PlayStation tracks. They are bought on the property market as your money allows; buy them steadily through the money stage of the roadmap rather than saving for all eight at once, since each garage is also storage for the vehicle hunts.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a keeper vehicle, register it in the app instead of abandoning it at the kerb; ten registrations accumulate quickly once you start collecting, and the hunt pairs naturally with Whip It Good's 100 discovered vehicles.
sources: Author's advice, reasoned from the official description
